interpretation: Positive native gain means PP cost exceeds model cost. Model scores use group normalization, while native gains retain halted-vehicle units; signs and descriptive association are reported without subtracting the two scales. The two replay arms cannot reconstruct the original eight-action group normalization. Collisions remain branch diagnostics and do not exclude valid pairs. Summary and extrema require all21 valid pairs and select no threshold or policy.
collision_accounting: Prefix and window counts remain separate for each branch; repeated-prefix incidents are not summed as unique experiment-wide incidents.
limitations: Previously inspected Cologne1 development seeds; no independent or cross-city confirmation.
Counterfactual PP branches share X prefixes, not the full-run PP trajectory; local advantages do not decompose the whole-run difference.
Three incomplete end windows are excluded by the same time-boundary rule.

outcome.description: All21 paired native-prefix comparisons are valid. Thirteen model actions reduce the original queue cost and eight increase it; the equal-seed mean model cost is1.57% higher than same-state PP.
outcome.score_interpretation: Eight accepted positive-score actions have negative actual gains. This establishes remaining action-sign/ranking errors on this roster. Group-normalized scores are not raw-cost predictions, so no cross-unit bias or MAE is reported.
outcome.comparison_scope: Each PP branch begins from the corresponding X native state. This result is a local-action diagnosis, not a new full-run policy comparison.

validation.native_pairs: All21 physical/executor states, pending-ID lists and prefix-decision histories match exactly between branches; all42 actual traces match the appropriate original X prefix and target treatment.
validation.costs: All42 branches have450 samples with consistent active-population accounting.
validation.units_correction: Removed direct group-normalized-score minus raw-cost errors from the analysis; the16 distinct focused tests include the corrected unit semantics.
